newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Globe, Pacific Gateway in phone pact.
newsitem.headline: Globe, Pacific Gateway in phone pact.

text.p: Globe Telecom said on Wednesday it had entered into an agreement with Pacific Gateway Exchange (PGE) to provide and enhance telecommunications services to Filipino communities in the United States.
In a statement, Globe assistant vice-president Benedict Buhain said that services such as direct dial from the U.S. will be introduced.
Pre-paid cards which allows automatic debit of calls made to the Philippines will be offered initially.
Globe is a joint venture of Ayala Corp and Singapore Telecommunications Ltd.

PGE is an international carrier with the seven largest U.S.-based long distance providers as its customers. It has partial ownership in 14 digital undersea fiber optic cable systems and operating agreements that provide for exchange of traffic with foreign carriers.

Another Philippine company, ABS-CBN Broadcasting Corp said earlier its subsidiary, ABS-CBN Telecom NA Inc, was ready to launch into the telecommunications market this year, also targetting the estimated six million Filipinos working overseas.
